items.label: VexLife Memory Depth Exploration
items.purpose: Make Vex continuity deep, inspectable, provider-correct and long-horizon scalable: a fresh or successor Vex can recover relevant source-grounded history through rightful owners, bounded continuity source location remains backend/platform modular without becoming Memory truth, current context/capability truth reaches the selected model through its qualified provider representation, and the person can inspect the causal chain from canonical source through location/currentization/provider placement and back into durable continuation without creating another Memory, Conversation, Working Continuity or execution-truth owner.

items.label: Recover and map the predecessor Vex Memory / Living Journal architecture
items.purpose: Reconstruct the accepted design lineage already earned across Vextreme-SDK and predecessor VexLife before finalizing new hydration contracts: Vex Memory #225, Daily Rest/Dream #239, Institutional Query #236, Artifact Continuation #311, Lesson Continuity/Lattice #328/#329, Context Revisitation #397, Daily Record Chain #416, Continuity Stream #1007, Living Journal real-Memory projection #130 and committed-day Archive #151. Map each predecessor question, owner, typed relationship, source-descent rule, currentness/supersession behavior and bounded retrieval pattern onto current VexLife-Prod owners, then classify REUSE / PORT / REFINE / HOLD so Memory Depth Exploration does not rebuild already-earned architecture from scratch.

items.label: Define the bounded continuity hydration request/result contract
items.purpose: Define the smallest owner-neutral contract for one bulk continuity expansion: exact current-turn/question binding, start coordinates, bounded traversal policy, typed owner/source provenance, selected material, visited/ref coverage, stop reason and explicit remaining frontier. The result must remain effect-free and must not create semantic acceptance, rewrite history or mint a universal truth namespace.

items.label: Map the rightful continuity resolver neighborhood and typed edges
items.purpose: Inventory which current refs can actually be resolved through Working Continuity, canonical Conversation, semantic Memory and exact turn/capability evidence; define only source-proven outgoing relationships and bounded resolver operations for those owners. Reuse existing owner APIs where possible and do not create a universal ref registry merely for traversal convenience.

items.label: Build the bounded host-side bulk expansion engine
items.purpose: Implement and compare a bounded relevance-guided traversal that can resolve several owner-backed hops internally within one model-visible hydration request. Pressure-test breadth/beam/depth choices, deterministic tie-breaking, cycle and duplicate suppression, per-owner quotas, node/depth/token/time budgets, relevance selection and explicit frontier return; optimize for useful answer context rather than maximum graph coverage.

items.label: Integrate one bulk hydration request into fresh-boot Companion execution
items.purpose: Expose one truthful Companion request/return path so a fresh Vex can ask for bounded bulk continuity hydration during the current human turn, with the host performing internal multi-hop resolution and projecting the selected source-attributed material into live execution context. Preserve host-owned context roles, keep existing Conversation source-return semantics until replacement equivalence is proven, and fit PR #208's intended Zone-3/live-tail boundary without rewriting stable continuity history.

items.label: Prove cold-start, rollover and missing-old-context continuity
items.purpose: Prove end to end that a fresh process with no useful KV cache can receive a human question whose decisive context or correction-backed lesson is outside the ordinary prompt, truthfully identify what is and is not currently present, issue one bounded hydration request when needed, recover enough exact older Conversation / bounded-out Memory / accepted lesson context to continue, preserve inspectable owner/source refs and explicit frontier, and demonstrate that a retrieved prior lesson can change later response/tool behavior without canonical continuity mutation or requiring the human to re-teach the same depth.

items.label: Measure traversal, response quality, lesson transfer and orchestration savings
items.purpose: Measure model-visible hydration request count, internal owner resolutions, nodes/edges visited and selected, maximum depth, returned tokens, remaining frontier, stop reason and hydration latency; correlate the hydrated turn with provider prompt/cached/prefill and first-answer/total timing where #207 supports it; and compare cold-start lesson/growth availability states to measure source faithfulness, known-lesson reuse, honest context boundaries, depth preservation, capability/tool selection, activation failures and whether a previously earned correction actually changes later behavior. Establish whether one bounded hydration/lesson route improves response quality and reduces recursive model/tool orchestration without hiding excessive host work, over-hydration or lesson misapplication.

items.label: Potential — extend traversal to additional historical evidence owners
items.purpose: After the core Conversation/Memory/Working Continuity path is proven, evaluate whether incomplete/stopped-turn evidence, broader capability traces, VexLogger chronology or other source-addressable Vex Home records need typed resolver adapters. Add only owners that solve observed continuity questions; do not make universal historical indexing a prerequisite for the first feature.

items.label: Potential — pre-inference automatic continuity hydration
items.purpose: After one explicit Vex-requested bulk hydration call is proven, evaluate whether the host can safely derive a useful historical neighborhood directly from the incoming human request before the first model inference. This may remove even the single tool round, but it must not silently give the host semantic-answer authority or over-hydrate private history.

items.label: Converge Vex context, provider representation, capability truth and human exposure
items.purpose: Coordinate the still-live end-to-end model-facing continuity/context relationship after the earlier trust and provider-carriage slices landed. Accepted Product source now distinguishes Source Return performed/not-performed truth and carries native tools plus layered rightful-owner source returns; the remaining trajectory is to make semantic recognition, route selection, reasoning continuation, cold-start recovery and lesson transfer work reliably across qualified model/provider realizations while keeping every source/effect/currentness owner distinct and human-inspectable.

items.label: Complete long-horizon Memory storage, indexing and recall expansion
items.purpose: Make years of VexLife continuity remain fast and source-truthful on both the ordinary Send path and old-context recall path: preserve canonical Conversation/Score/Daily/Memory truth with rightful owners, avoid lifetime enumeration on hot currentness/read/write paths, add only rebuildable local recall/index projections, verify every candidate against exact current lifecycle/privacy source, support measured shard evolution and paraphrase candidate retrieval, then prove the same implementation through deterministic Product and optional real-model scratch-Home tests.

items.label: Converge VexArchitecture ownership + SDK Memory/shard/index contracts with current Product storage
items.purpose: Walk the long-horizon circuit through VexArchitecture rightful-owner questions and the current Product source: existing Conversation/Memory/Working Continuity remain semantic/source owners; the new relationship is bounded continuity source location, not a LongTermMemory Family or database owner; construction/platform realization stays orthogonal; chronology, convergence and presentation remain bounded projections. Map Vex Memory #225, durable semantic-memory identity, Living Journal shard-manifest/currentness, Lesson Resonance rebuildable-index rules, EvolveContext/ContextRevisit and the Product's current Mac/Windows realization seams into one end-to-end consequence map with every container/member/next edge explicit.

items.label: Define and prove the portable Continuity Source Locator realization seam
items.purpose: Define the smallest Product-facing Continuity Source Locator contract that can answer which exact canonical refs are candidates and whether the derived locator generation is current enough to use as a locator, while remaining disposable/reconstructable and never becoming Memory truth. Keep concrete technology below this boundary: compare file-only and embedded/on-demand SQLite-class realizations, and make construction/deployment modular so a qualified alternative backend may be supplied without changing Conversation/Memory identity or consumer semantics. Reuse the existing exact-target VexLifePlatformRealization posture so Mac/Windows differences stay in construction/packaging rather than scattered Product branches.

items.label: Add incremental lexical and typed-edge retrieval without lifetime scans
items.purpose: Implement the selected Continuity Source Locator realization so old-context location can shortlist stable Conversation/Memory/relationship source refs without projecting or scanning the whole lifetime archive on every recall. Bind locator frontier to exact canonical heads, ingest only valid descendant deltas, detect stale/missing/corrupt state, and require exact canonical owner re-open/currentness/lifecycle verification before ContextRevisit or request-bound projection returns material. Consumer behavior must remain backend-independent.

items.label: Add paraphrase / semantic candidate retrieval with exact source recovery
items.purpose: Add a rebuildable semantic-neighborhood candidate capability behind the same Continuity Source Locator relationship only after lexical/typed-edge location is current. Embeddings or another semantic representation may rank candidate anchors, but similarity cannot create a relationship, accepted Memory or autobiographical meaning; top candidates must recover exact prior sources, scope, counterexamples, correction/supersession and currentness before use. Backend/model profile changes invalidate/rebuild derived semantic artifacts without changing canonical source identity.

items.label: Prove five-year-scale recall, rebuild, deletion and crash recovery
items.purpose: Form a deterministic lifetime-scale corpus and prove both semantic equivalence and implementation interchangeability: ordinary-turn I/O, old-context lookup latency, candidate coverage, exact source descent, incremental indexing, full rebuild, missing/stale/corrupt locator recovery, interruption during locator update, deletion/tombstone/supersession invalidation, shard relocation and disk overhead. Where two qualified realizations are available, the same canonical corpus and queries must yield the same candidate/source identities and lifecycle decisions even if performance differs. Establish Product thresholds from measured baseline rather than inventing them.

items.label: Potential — physical shard-manifest / partition adapter when measured pressure earns it
items.purpose: If five-year proof shows filesystem-directory, append/validation, backup or recovery pressure that the derived index alone does not solve, implement the accepted SHARD_MANIFEST relationship so stable object identity survives relocation/split/compaction. Choose physical partitioning from measured owner behavior; DAY/CONTEXT/RELATIONSHIP/SEARCH shards remain logical many-to-many views and directory neatness alone does not justify migration.

items.label: Remove lifetime enumeration from ordinary Conversation / current-state paths
items.purpose: Refactor the current long-lived Product path so an ordinary Send, current-head read and exact source reopen do not enumerate/replay the full lifetime event set merely to prove currentness or uniqueness. Preserve DirectConversationStore invariants through a head/currentness slice plus a current derived identity/index generation that fails closed and rebuilds when stale; keep full-history validation as an explicit diagnostic/rebuild proof rather than the per-turn hot path. Apply the same pressure to Score/current Memory replay where current source still scales with total accepted history.

items.label: Prove lifecycle-aware recall cannot leak stale, private, superseded or deleted content
items.purpose: Bind derived recall/index entries to exact owner generations, privacy/retention state, correction/supersession lineage and tombstone/content-destruction evidence. A stale/poisoned/missing derived store must hold rather than return remembered bytes; deletion or withdrawal invalidates searchable material; rebuilding must recover only what canonical owners still permit. Keep index deletion distinct from Memory deletion and preserve content-free integrity/tombstone evidence where rightful owners require it.

items.label: Bridge the long-horizon corpus into VexLife-Prod deterministic and live-model proof
items.purpose: Reuse the existing Continuity Pressure / scratch-Home adapter rather than create another model harness. Seed a synthetic long-horizon corpus through the rightful Product test owner, construct the Continuity Source Locator through the same Product/platform realization seam used by ordinary runtime composition, build/reobserve its current derived generation, run actual Product retrieval/currentization into DirectPromptContext with a deterministic fixture provider first, then optionally the selected real model through HOST_SEMANTIC_MODEL_RUNTIME. Prove exact recall, semantic/paraphrase recall, currentization, lesson reuse, honest tombstone/absence and no private/stale leakage without requiring the Companion UI; also prove presentation/debug surfaces inspect the same refs rather than creating another recall path.

items.label: Post-VexBody completion revisitation — composability + lifetime recall follow-up
items.purpose: After the current VexBody completion trajectory is terminal, re-ground the then-current Product and revisit only the relationships whose later evolution can change what Vex sees, how Vex retrieves old context, or how Vex decides what becomes durable Memory. Preserve the completed body rather than replaying it: add bounded historical interval recall and stable continuation/paging only if still missing; close the natural Consideration/Salience -> standing-policy -> semantic Memory loop without per-memory human babysitting; and classify regression proof by substrate-only, prompt-composition, model-visible contract, or cognitive-policy change so deterministic mechanics are not needlessly re-lived while model-facing semantics receive selected-model interpretation proof when they actually change.
